summary: 70/122 confirms the inherited sense schelten, ausschelten and the government ʕal: aʕlayye identifies the birds as the target of the mistress’s scolding. Her ensuing question supplies the content.

Gəmzaʕbro is the supplied 3sg.f Infectum with prospective gə- in a conditional prediction; this is not a ko-Preterit or a Detransitive. Retain the inherited stem label I and the entry’s base forms mzaʕballe/mzaʕbər.

The reader proposes an addition to a thin cell but explicitly notes that 70/122 is already cited. Existing and supplied excerpts differ in source transcription and segmentation of prefixes; that does not constitute a second occurrence, a new form box or grounds for rewriting the inherited spelling.
The coordinated verb gmazəḥqo contributes shouting. This single coordinated passage does not establish an independent sense or a fixed idiom for zʕbr.

Jan 2.4/866 supplies plural mzaʕbəriwo in a past-directed question, coordinated with mhawriwo; it adds Infectum-wa to the inherited Infectum. Stem I and mzaʕballe/mzaʕbər are retained despite the quadriliteral root.

The overt target ʕal nošo independently supports the inherited government and the round-1 analysis of aʕlayye. The adjacent shouting verb and the machine translation rage do not justify a separate anger sense. The question asks whether the conduct occurred; it is not an assertion that it did.
